descriptions.w3d_input_owner_on_message_8012028c: Handles input messages: may switch the camera to its default mode, or resets camera blend when the watched payload is deleted.
descriptions.w3d_entity_point_or_zero_801212d4: Asks an entity for a named point; if the lookup fails the output vector is set to the global zero vector.
descriptions.w3d_input_owner_post_reorient_80121568: If the referenced entity is a worm, posts a worm reorient message carrying that worm's identifier.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_list_get_801217: Returns the global registry list that tracks every live trail graphic entity instance.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_unlink_80121760: Removes a trail graphic entity from its type registry list and decrements the registered count.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_create_801217a4: Allocates a 1460-byte trail graphic entity, runs its constructor, adds it to the type registry list and bumps the count.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_release_8012180: Drops one trail graphic entity reference; at zero it unlinks the object from its registry and runs the deleting destructor.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_retain_80121860: Adds one reference to a trail graphic entity and returns the previous reference count.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_destroy_8012194: Trail graphic entity destructor: restores its vtable, releases 8 held interfaces, frees a string, then runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_handle_message_: Trail graphic entity message handler: attach (64) runs the base handler then a setup step; detach (66) runs cleanup first.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_attach_801222b8: Makes this trail graphic entity the current one and clears two of its state fields.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_set_segment_801: Stores a start and end point into one slot of the trail's 20-entry segment table and marks that slot as used.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_set_flag_80122a: Sets a flag field of the trail graphic entity to 1.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_attach_interfac: Looks up a shared interface by its identifier, holds a reference while passing it to the entity, then releases it.
Second copy of the lookup-and-attach helper: holds a looked-up interface while handing it to the entity.
descriptions.w3d_trail_graphic_entity_detach_80123e88: Empty detach step for the trail graphic entity.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_list_get_80123f18: Returns the global registry list that tracks every live transition service instance.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_unlink_80123f24: Removes a transition service from its type registry list and decrements the registered count.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_create_80123f68: Allocates a 64-byte transition service, runs its constructor, adds it to the type registry list and bumps the count.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_release_80123fc8: Drops one transition service reference; at zero it unlinks the object from its registry and runs the deleting destructor.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_retain_80124024: Adds one reference to a transition service and returns the previous reference count.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_construct_8012403: Transition service constructor: clears its slots, counts the in and out transition name tables and records the instance.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_destroy_80124100: Transition service destructor: restores its vtable, releases 5 held interfaces, then runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_tick_801242bc: Per-tick update for the transition service; runs the update step and returns 20.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_attach_801242e0: Clears the transition state and subscribes the service to its three transition messages.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_detach_801243b0: Clears the transition state, releases the mesh and owner interfaces and forgets the global instance.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_circle_in_8012442: Posts a transition-started message, loads the transition mesh and plays a randomly chosen 'in' transition.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_circle_out_801244: Posts a transition-started message, loads the transition mesh and plays a randomly chosen 'out' transition.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_update_8012458c: Polls the playing transition; when it ends it posts a completion message or tears the mesh down.
descriptions.w3d_transition_service_is_busy_801248cc: Returns 1 while a transition animation is still playing, otherwise 0.
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_list_get_8012: Returns the global registry list that tracks every live trigger graphic entity instance.
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_unlink_80124a: Removes a trigger graphic entity from its type registry list and decrements the registered count.
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_create_80124a: Allocates a 36-byte trigger graphic entity, runs its constructor, adds it to the type registry list and bumps the count.
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_release_80124: Drops one trigger graphic entity reference; at zero it unlinks the object from its registry and runs the deleting destructor.
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_retain_80124b: Adds one reference to a trigger graphic entity and returns the previous reference count.
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_construct_801: Trigger graphic entity constructor: runs the entity base constructor, sets the vtable and clears two slots.
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_destroy_80124: Trigger graphic entity destructor: restores its vtable, releases 1 held interface, then runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_handle_messag: Trigger graphic entity message handler: attach (64) runs the base handler then a setup step; detach (66) runs cleanup first.
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_priority_8012: Returns -1 (appears to be a default priority or index value).
descriptions.w3d_trigger_graphic_entity_detach_80124d: Empty detach step for the trigger graphic entity.
descriptions.w3d_component_list_get_80124db8: Returns the global registry list that tracks every live component instance.
descriptions.w3d_component_unlink_80124dc4: Removes a component from its type registry list and decrements the registered count.
descriptions.w3d_component_create_80124e08: Allocates a 120-byte component, runs its constructor, adds it to the type registry list and bumps the count.
descriptions.w3d_component_release_80124e68: Drops one component reference; at zero it unlinks the object from its registry and runs the deleting destructor.
descriptions.w3d_component_retain_80124ec4: Adds one reference to a component and returns the previous reference count.
descriptions.w3d_component_destroy_80124f4c: Component destructor: restores its vtable, releases 3 held interfaces, destroys a handle member, then runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_component_handle_message_80124ff0: Trigger-zone message handler: attach/detach plus two named messages forwarded to target and worm-movement checks.
descriptions.w3d_component_tick_801250c4: Per-tick update for the trigger zone; runs its update step unless the game reports a paused state, and returns 20.
descriptions.w3d_component_detach_80125404: Posts a message carrying the zone's handle when the trigger-zone entity detaches.
descriptions.w3d_component_on_target_8012545c: Finishes the trigger-zone entity when an incoming message names its target identifier.
descriptions.w3d_component_post_text_8012568c: Posts a string message with the given text under a fixed cached message name.
descriptions.w3d_component_radius_801256e4: Returns a pointer to the trigger zone's radius field.
descriptions.w3d_component_position_801256ec: Returns a pointer to the trigger zone's centre position.
descriptions.w3d_component_on_worm_entered_80125aa0: When the zone is armed, checks a worm's team and identity filters and records it as the triggering worm.
